title: Smoked Cowboy Candy
description: Smoked candied jalapenos: sliced jalapenos smoked in a Traeger, then simmered in an apricot preserves, hot honey, and cider vinegar syrup.

ingredients.note: not visible in step 3 of the source; unconfirmed when it goes in (most likely step 3)
jar size not given in the source

steps: Put them on a baking tray in a Traeger at 375F for 45 minutes.
In a pan on low heat, combine the apricot preserves, hot honey, apple cider vinegar, black pepper and minced garlic, and bring to a low simmer.
Add the smoked jalapenos, stir, and simmer 15 minutes.
